proposals.before: The rebels fled toward Lu'an; at Yangcheng Wenzhao let them pass, then marched secretly from Qinshui and struck them at Qindi and Liucunzhai, taking more than a thousand heads.
proposals.after: The rebels fled toward Lu'an; at Yangcheng, Wenzhao let them pass, then marched secretly from Qinshui and struck them at Qindi and Liucunzhai, taking more than a thousand heads.
proposals.reason: English fuses the place Yangcheng with the name Wenzhao; a comma is required so the subject is Wenzhao at Yangcheng, matching 文诏至陽城.

proposals.before: The rebels had already beaten Deng Yin's force at Lin County; Wenzhao led five camps in a night attack and routed them.
proposals.after: The rebels had already beaten Deng Qi's force at Lin County; Wenzhao led five camps in a night attack and routed them.
proposals.reason: 邓玘 is Deng Qi (玘 Qǐ), not Deng Yin.

proposals.before: But the bandits had already defeated Deng Yin's troops at Lin County; Wenzhao led the five-camp army in a night raid and broke them.
proposals.after: But the bandits had already defeated Deng Qi's troops at Lin County; Wenzhao led the five-camp army in a night raid and broke them.
proposals.reason: 邓玘 is Deng Qi (玘 Qǐ), not Deng Yin.

proposals.before: In the seventh month he routed the Huaqing rebels at Chailing Village, killed their chief Rolling Earth Dragon, and pursued Old Huihui to Jiyuan and killed him.
proposals.after: In the seventh month he routed the Huaiqing rebels at Chailing Village, killed their chief Rolling Earth Dragon, and pursued Old Huihui to Jiyuan and killed him.
proposals.reason: 懷慶 is Huaiqing, not Huaqing.

proposals.before: In the seventh month he utterly defeated the Huaqing bandits at Chailing Village, beheaded their chieftain Rolling Earth Dragon, and again pursued and beheaded Old Huihui at Jiyuan.
proposals.after: In the seventh month he utterly defeated the Huaiqing bandits at Chailing Village, beheaded their chieftain Rolling Earth Dragon, and again pursued and beheaded Old Huihui at Jiyuan.
proposals.reason: 懷慶 is Huaiqing, not Huaqing.

proposals.before: At midnight Wenzhao led his nephew Bianjiao, garrison commander Dingjiao, and regional commander Bai Guang'en into the forest, routed the rebels, and pursued them to Jinling River.
proposals.after: At midnight Wenzhao led his nephews, assistant general Bianjiao and garrison commander Dingjiao, together with regional commander Bai Guang'en and others, routed the rebels in the deep forest, and pursued them to Jinling River.
proposals.reason: Chinese 從子 applies to both 變蛟 and 鼎蛟, and 參將/守備 are their offices; the idiomatic English treats only Bianjiao as nephew and drops Dingjiao's nephew status and Bianjiao's office.

proposals.before: The vanguard central commander Liu Honglie was captured; soon the deputy commanders Ai Wannian and Liu Guozhen again died in battle.
proposals.after: The vanguard central commander Liu Honglie was captured; soon the deputy commanders Ai Wannian and Liu Guozhen also died in battle.
proposals.reason: 復 here means a further loss in the same campaign, not that Ai and Liu died a second time.

proposals.before: Only my troops are already divided, and there is no one who can plan support.
proposals.after: But my troops are already divided, and there is no one who can be sent in support.
proposals.reason: 顧 is adversative 'but/however', not 'only'; 策應 is rear/support response, not 'plan support'.

proposals.before: His comrades only eyed him and laughed.
proposals.after: His comrades all eyed him and laughed.
proposals.reason: 鹹 stands for 咸 'all'; 'only' reverses the meaning of the comrades' unanimous mockery.

proposals.before: Along more than a thousand li of river the rebels could cross anywhere; Yuji posted troops on the upper reaches, left the lower crossing at Puyuan to grand coordinator Cai Maode, and asked the court for reinforcements.
proposals.after: Along more than a thousand li of river the rebels could cross anywhere; Yuji posted troops on the upper reaches, left the lower crossing at Puban to grand coordinator Cai Maode, and asked the court for reinforcements.
proposals.reason: 蒲阪 is Puban (ancient Puzhou), not Puyuan.

proposals.before: Yuji reasoned that along more than a thousand li of river the bandits could cross anywhere; he divided troops to hold the upper reaches and assigned the lower reaches at Puyuan to the grand coordinator Cai Maode, while requesting reinforcements from the court.
proposals.after: Yuji reasoned that along more than a thousand li of river the bandits could cross anywhere; he divided troops to hold the upper reaches and assigned the lower reaches at Puban to the grand coordinator Cai Maode, while requesting reinforcements from the court.
proposals.reason: Same error: 蒲阪 should be Puban, not Puyuan.

proposals.before: Huang Degong, styled Tiger Mountain, was a native of Kaiyuan Guard; his family had moved from Hefei.
proposals.after: Huang Degong, sobriquet Hushan, was a native of Kaiyuan Guard; his family had moved from Hefei.
proposals.reason: 號虎山 is a hao (sobriquet), not a courtesy name; Tiger Mountain is a calque of 虎山.

proposals.before: In Chongzhen 17 he was made Marquis Who Pacifies the South.
proposals.after: In Chongzhen 17 he was made Earl Who Pacifies the South.
proposals.reason: 靖南伯 is an earl/count (伯); 侯 (marquis) comes only in the next sentence.

proposals.before: In the seventeenth year he was enfeoffed as Marquis Who Pacifies the South.
proposals.after: In the seventeenth year he was enfeoffed as Earl Who Pacifies the South.
proposals.reason: 靖南伯 is 伯, not marquis.

proposals.before: At Tuqiao Degong was eating when the ambush sprang up; he mounted, raised his iron whip, arrows fell like rain, his horse went down, and he leaped to another horse and fled.
proposals.after: At Tuqiao, Degong was eating when the ambush sprang up; he mounted, raised his iron whip, arrows fell like rain, his horse went down, and he leaped to another horse and fled.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic English fuses the place 土橋 with the personal name 得功 as if they were a single name.

proposals.before: Kefa sent supervising general Wan Yuanji to mediate, but Degong would not agree.
proposals.after: Kefa sent the army supervisor Wan Yuanji to mediate, but a settlement could not be reached.
proposals.reason: 不可 states that mediation failed without naming Degong as the sole refuser; 監軍 is an army supervisor, not a supervising general.

proposals.before: He moved his household to Taiping, devoted himself to fighting rebels, and was made Left Pillar of State for his merit.
proposals.after: He was ordered to move his household and garrison to Taiping, devote himself solely to dealing with the rebels, and for his merit was additionally made Left Pillar of State.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic rendering drops 命, 鎮, and 加 from 命移家鎮太平 and 論功加左柱國.

proposals.before: The commentator says: Cao Wenzhao and the others possessed fierce and valiant gifts; wherever they turned they crushed defeat, and all were called match for ten thousand men.
proposals.after: The commentator says: Cao Wenzhao and the others possessed fierce and valiant gifts; wherever they turned they crushed the enemy, and all were called a match for ten thousand men.
proposals.reason: 所向摧敗 means they crushed opponents wherever they went; crushed defeat reverses the object.

decisions.reason: The Chinese note is 〈（弟文耀）〉; the English already uses parentheses for （）, so the leftover book-title closer 〉 is stray source punctuation, not part of the translation.
Same stray 〉 on the literal field; removing it restores the English note without changing the kinship or name 弟文耀.
陷中部 is the capture of Zhongbu county, which can then be 圍之; rendering 中部 as a vague 'central region' is a toponym error.
The literal field has the same false gloss of 中部; Zhongbu is the place seized and then besieged.
A comma after Yangcheng is optional English punctuation. 'at Yangcheng Wenzhao let them pass' already reads as locative plus subject Wenzhao, matching 文詔至陽城遇賊不擊, not a fused personal name.
鄧玘 is Deng Qi (玘 Qǐ). Yin is a wrong reading of 玘 and invents another general.
The literal field repeats Deng Yin for 鄧玘; Deng Qi is the correct name.
懷慶 is the prefecture Huaiqing, not Huaqing; the rest of the sentence (柴陵村, 滾地龍, 老回回, 濟源) is unchanged.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 七月大敗懷慶賊柴陵村

decisions.reason: Same Huaiqing correction on the literal field for 懷慶.
從子 governs both 參將變蛟 and 守備鼎蛟; 等 includes Bai Guang'en with others; 敗賊深林中 is the fight in the deep forest. The original makes only Bianjiao a nephew, drops 參將, and omits 等.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 率從子參將變蛟、守備鼎蛟、都司白廣恩等敗賊深林中

decisions.reason: After 劉弘烈被執, 復戰死 marks a further loss (also died in battle), not that Ai Wannian and Liu Guozhen died a second time.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 俄副將艾萬年、柳國鎮復戰死

decisions.reason: 顧 is adversative 'but', not 'only'; 策應 is sending support, not 'plan support'. The replacement matches 顧吾兵已分，無可策應者 and the following 為後勁.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 顧吾兵已分，無可策應者

decisions.reason: 同輩鹹目笑之 uses 鹹 for 咸 'all'. 'Only' reverses the comrades' shared mockery.
下流蒲阪 is the Yellow River crossing Puban (蒲坂/蒲阪), not Puyuan.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以下流蒲阪屬之巡撫蔡懋德

decisions.reason: The literal field has the same false toponym Puyuan for 蒲阪; Puban is required.
號虎山 is a hao, not a courtesy name (字), so 'styled' is wrong; Hushan is the name, and 'Tiger Mountain' is only a calque.
十七年封靖南伯 is an earldom (伯). 進封侯 in the next sentence is the later promotion to marquis, so 'Marquis' here is the wrong rank.
The literal field likewise calls 靖南伯 a marquis; Earl matches 伯, with 侯 only at 進封侯.
A comma after Tuqiao is optional. 'At Tuqiao Degong was eating' already takes 土橋 as the place and 得功 as the subject, matching 得功行至土橋，方作食.
監軍 is an army supervisor, not a supervising general. 和解之，不可 reports that mediation failed without naming Degong as the sole refuser.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 可法命監軍萬元吉和解之，不可

decisions.after: He was ordered to move his household and garrison to Taiping and devote himself solely to dealing with the rebels; for his merit he was additionally made Left Pillar of State.
decisions.reason: The original drops 命, 鎮, and 加. The proposal restores them but yokes the 論功加 clause onto the same 'ordered to' infinitives; the order is 移家鎮太平 and 一意辦賊, while 加左柱國 is a separate reward.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 命移家鎮太平，一意辦賊，論功加左柱國

decisions.reason: 所向摧敗 means they crushed the enemy wherever they went; 'crushed defeat' inverts the object. Adding the article in 'a match for ten thousand men' is required English for 萬人敵.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 所向摧敗，皆所稱萬人敵也

claimRevisions.reason: The English personal name Deng Yin was produced by misreading 鄧玘; the repair restores Deng Qi, matching the given-name pinyin already stored on the claim.
The event place English Puyuan is a false reading of 蒲阪; Puban is the lower Yellow River crossing assigned in this sentence.
Cai Maode's assigned place was extracted as Puyuan from the same bad gloss of 蒲阪; the toponym is Puban.
The title English Marquis Who Pacifies the South contradicts 靖南伯; 伯 is earl, and marquis (侯) is the later 進封侯.
